## Station

I operate HF, VHF, and UHF using a mixture of fixed, mobile, and portable equipment, with a particular focus on digital modes and SDR-based systems.

My current setup includes:

- HF base and portable operation (including POTA)
- VHF/UHF FM and digital voice, in the shack and mobile
- Homebrew and commercial SDR receivers
- Raspberry Pi–based packet and digital voice infrastructure

Several of these have grown into projects in their own right — the
[GB7CAM packet node](projects/gb7cam.qmd), my
[MMDVM digital voice hotspot](projects/mmdvm-hotspot.qmd), a
[Raspberry Pi IQ visualiser](projects/raspberry-pi-sdr.qmd), and the
[memory-channel builder](projects/radio-memory-builder.qmd) that programmes my
Yaesu radios.

I periodically update this page as my setup evolves.
